oneLineDefinition: A broad management degree covering strategy, operations, human resources, marketing, and finance — designed to prepare graduates for leadership roles across all types of organizations.
overview: Business Administration is the widest-scope business major, touching every core function of a company: strategy, marketing, operations, HR, accounting, and finance. It does not go as deep as specialized majors (Finance, Marketing, HR) but provides a comprehensive view of how businesses work holistically. In Vietnam, QTKD is one of the most common degrees and produces graduates who go into roles across virtually every industry. Its breadth makes it flexible but also means self-directed specialization is important after graduation.
typicalProjects: Write a business plan for a startup concept
Conduct a SWOT and competitive analysis for a real company
Develop a go-to-market strategy for a new product
Analyze an operations bottleneck and recommend improvements
Present a strategic recommendation to a simulated board
requiredSkills: Communication — written reports and verbal presentations
Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete information
Ability to learn quickly across multiple functional areas
suitableFor: Students who want to run or manage businesses, not just one functional area
Those who are interested in entrepreneurship or family business succession
Students who prefer variety across marketing, operations, finance, and people management
Those who want maximum flexibility in career options after graduation
notSuitableFor: Students who want deep technical or specialized expertise from day one
Those who dislike ambiguous, people-heavy work environments
Students who need a clear, defined skill output from their degree
keyTakeaways: QTKD is a generalist degree — value comes from how you specialize afterward, not from the degree name alone
The most successful QTKD graduates combine the degree with real internship experience and a chosen specialization
The degree is widely available and very common in Vietnam — standing out requires more than just the diploma
An MBA later in career significantly amplifies a QTKD foundation
cautionNotes: QTKD is one of the most common majors in Vietnam — job market competition at entry level is high
Without a specialization or strong internship record, graduates often struggle to differentiate themselves
The broad curriculum means some programs cover many topics superficially
marketDemand: High volume, high competition. QTKD graduates are hired everywhere but the sheer number of graduates means employers increasingly look for specialization, English proficiency, and internship experience.
salaryOutlook: Entry-level roles earn 8–15M VND/month. Management positions with 3–5 years of experience earn 20–40M. Senior managers and directors at large companies earn significantly more. Salary varies more by industry and company than by major.
futureTrend: Business generalists are being supplemented by AI tools for analysis and reporting. QTKD graduates who combine management skills with digital literacy (data analytics, digital marketing, automation) are more competitive than pure generalists.
commonMisconceptions: QTKD is an easy backup major — strong programs are genuinely demanding in strategy, finance, and operations
QTKD leads directly to a management role — most graduates start in junior individual contributor positions before progressing to management
A QTKD degree alone is enough to start a successful business — entrepreneurship requires skills the degree introduces but does not fully develop

faq.question: Is QTKD a good major for starting a business?
faq.answer: It provides useful foundational knowledge — business planning, marketing, operations, basic finance. However, entrepreneurship is mostly learned by doing. QTKD gives you a map, not the territory. Real experience, mentorship, and industry knowledge matter more than the degree for startup success.

faq.question: Should I choose QTKD or a specialized business major?
faq.answer: If you already know which function interests you (marketing, finance, HR), study that directly — you will go deeper faster. Choose QTKD if you are genuinely undecided or want to run a business holistically. The caveat: specialize quickly after year two regardless of which path you choose.
